resources.string: Reach your weekly goal to start a streak.
Pause active – your streak is frozen.

Climbers rest on purpose, so CruxCoach counts weeks, not days. A week counts when you reach your weekly goal of training days – board sessions count automatically. Weeks you are ill, injured or on holiday freeze the streak. Every four good weeks earn a joker (max. two) that quietly protects one missed week.
Optional, four taps. 1 = bad, 5 = great. Every answer can only make the day gentler.
You feel ill – rest and recover. Your streak is paused.
Injury mode: climbing is paused. Off-wall training that spares the injured area is fine.
An injury is open – exercises that load it are marked.
Tired fingers – no max finger load today. Pull, core, legs or mobility are fine.
Skin needs a break – skip the board. Hangboard on bigger edges or strength work instead.
Short on sleep – keep volume low, technique and mobility work well.
Low energy – an easy session or a rest day.
Low motivation – something short and fun counts too.
Tell CruxCoach your equipment and it only suggests exercises you can do.
Max hang, pull-ups and hollow hold show your progress in strength to weight.
Needed for percent of body weight on the hangboard and for fueling targets.

Climbing rewards strength to weight, and that can tempt people into eating too little. Too little energy for the training you do (relative energy deficiency in sport, RED-S) costs strength, recovery and health – bones, hormones, immune system. CruxCoach only notices patterns and never diagnoses. If several signs fit you – lasting tiredness, frequent illness, missed periods, dizziness, stalling despite training – talk to a doctor or a sports dietitian.
Your body weight is below the range climbing federations use for health checks.
Your weight trend has been falling quickly.
On several training days you logged far less carbohydrate than the training needs.
Your weight-loss goal is paused while these signs are present.
More loading days than in the three weeks before. Not a ban – just worth knowing.
Log your body weight to see protein and carbohydrate targets.
Max hang, pick-up, weighted pull-up: from what you can do, CruxCoach plans your loads.
